summary: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose the statistical analysis plan (SAP) for an interim analysis of its Phase 2/3 trial of tafenoquine in severe babesiosis. The filing describes the interim analysis triggers, conditional power thresholds, sample size reassessment, and plan to apply for a priority review voucher if data support an sNDA submission by Q1 2028. No M&A, capital markets, or restructuring event is reported. This is a routine clinical-trial update, not a special situation.
